requirement: The insulation resistance between different parts of the E-bike electrical system and between parts and ground shall be greater than the specified minimum values to prevent leakage and short circuits.
requirement_summary: E-bike electrical insulation resistance must exceed specified minimums

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 insulation impedance test report showing resistance above minimum values

remediation: Ensure E-bike electrical system passes UL 2849 insulation impedance test with resistance values above specified minimums to prevent leakage and short circuits.

requirement: The E-bike electrical system shall pass a dielectric withstand (hi-pot) test, with no insulation breakdown occurring at test voltages higher than normal operating voltage.
requirement_summary: E-bike must pass hi-pot test with no insulation breakdown at elevated voltage

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 dielectric withstand (hi-pot) test report showing no insulation breakdown

remediation: Ensure E-bike electrical system passes UL 2849 dielectric withstand test without insulation breakdown at elevated test voltages.

requirement: The E-bike electrical system shall pass the IPX4 water exposure test (splashing water from all directions) without creating a safety hazard.
requirement_summary: E-bike must pass IPX4 splash-water test without safety hazard

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 IPX4 water exposure test report showing no safety hazard after splash testing

remediation: Ensure E-bike electrical system passes UL 2849 IPX4 water exposure test without safety hazards. Improve sealing and waterproofing of electrical connections as needed.

requirement: The E-bike battery management system (BMS) shall pass software evaluation and functional safety assessment to ensure software does not cause safety hazards due to faults.
requirement_summary: BMS must pass software evaluation and functional safety assessment

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 software evaluation report for BMS
Functional safety assessment documentation for BMS software

remediation: Ensure BMS passes UL 2849 software evaluation and functional safety assessment. Address any identified software faults that could lead to safety hazards.

requirement: The E-bike charger shall comply with UL 2849 safety requirements, including input testing, temperature testing, and charging protection functions.
requirement_summary: Charger must meet UL 2849 safety requirements (input, temp, protection)

evidence_required.description: UL 2849 charger test report including input, temperature, and protection function tests
Charger specification sheet documenting safety features and protection functions

remediation: Ensure the E-bike charger complies with UL 2849 safety requirements for input testing, temperature testing, and charging protection functions.
